description:
After the extractions the worst remaining function is ~13-14 (one-table dispatch). Calibrate, do not bless:
- .credo.exs: Credo.Check.Refactor.Nesting [max_nesting: 3] (clears the 8 depth-3 AST-lowering idioms; 4+ still caught)
- .credo.exs: Credo.Check.Refactor.CyclomaticComplexity [max_complexity: 15] (covers single-table functions with margin; still catches growth)
- test/resume_test.exs:10 shapes (20, depth 4): extract or file-exclude — decide and record.
Requires an ADR.
title: Credo: calibrate complexity/nesting thresholds
